verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is explicitly a terminal-based agentic coding tool with strong docs on codebase querying, editing, and agentic workflows (gh-1,gh-3,gh-4). However community reports are sharply split: some praise its huge context window (comm-1, comm-12), while many report it getting stuck in loops, poor agentic navigation, ignoring instructions, and even catastrophic file-deletion incidents (comm-6, comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15, comm-16).
